official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Agreement By and Between Owner and Contractor - Bay Construction Company, Oakland, CA (“Contractor”), for the latter to provide Fence Installation, for the Frick Middle School Intensive Support Site Project, as described in Article I of the Agreement, in the amount of $160,000.00, which includes a contingency of $30,000.00, as the lowest responsive bidder, and rejecting all other bids, if any, and authorizing the President and Secretary of the Board to sign the Agreement for same with said bidder with the work scheduled to commence on June 17, 2021, and scheduled to last for Sixty (60) Calendar days, ending August 16, 2021.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Awards Bay Construction $160,000 to install a fence at Frick Middle School
summary: The district is hiring Bay Construction Company of Oakland, the lowest responsive bidder, to install a fence at the Frick Middle School Intensive Support Site for $160,000, which includes a $30,000 contingency. Work is scheduled to start June 17, 2021 and last 60 calendar days, ending August 16, 2021.
pulled_from_consent: Adopted in its own vote at this meeting (7–0), instead of with the rest of the consent report.
outcome_action: Adopted
